extracted.intended_audience: Registered patent attorneys/agents, practitioner support individuals, and independent inventors who will file or view patent applications using USPTO Patent Center
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural and technical requirements and user guidance for preparing, uploading, validating, paying for, and submitting patent applications and follow-on documents using the USPTO Patent Center web tool.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access requirements for full features
rubrics_metrics.description: To access all features of Patent Center, you must be a registered patent attorney/agent, practitioner support individual, or an Independent Inventor, have a Customer Number assigned to the profile, and have a USPTO.gov login to obtain secure transmission of the application to the USPTO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications associated to the Customer Numbers listed in a Registered User’s profile are available for review; Private view displays when associated to the user’s profile.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registered Patent Center user definition
rubrics_metrics.description: A Registered Patent Center user has both a USPTO.gov account and is registered with Patent Center.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Registered users must sign in using two-step authentication to gain full access to Patent Center features; registered users see Workbench and Manage information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Two-step authentication requirement and behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: Two-step authentication involves providing a valid USPTO.gov account/password and then entering a one-time PIN sent by email or mobile authenticator.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: User may indicate 'This is a computer that I trust and use regularly' to re-authenticate within 24 hours without a PIN; steps: Sign in → Enter credentials → Select method → Retrieve PIN → Enter PIN.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guest Patent Center user limitations
rubrics_metrics.description: Patent Center allows guest users but with limited functionality compared to registered users.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guest users will see a Patent Center account information area and can file new submissions but cannot file documents in existing applications/patents (only Registered Users may do follow-on filings). Guest Users may only pay by credit card.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal equivalence of electronic submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: Patent Center submissions are legally equivalent to paper-based patent application and document submission methods and provide filers with the same protections as traditional methods.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submission Receipt is legally binding proof of date and time of the submission; an official filing receipt will be mailed from the Office of Patent Application Processing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supported document file types
rubrics_metrics.description: Patent Center accepts only DOCX, PDF, TXT or PCT Zip file types for uploads.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Drag and Drop or Select and Attach to upload; for multi-section documents, indicate document description and corresponding pages; enter document description when not detected by the system.

rubrics_metrics.name: Individual document size limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Each uploaded document may not exceed 25MB.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Exception: One sequence listing in TXT format may be up to 100MB per submission; documents exceeding limits will cause validation errors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Documents per submission limit
rubrics_metrics.description: You may upload up to 100 documents for each submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Multi-Doc splitting is limited to 60 lines of document description (each line equals a document).

rubrics_metrics.name: Sequence listing requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Sequence listings in TXT format must conform to ST.24 or ST.25 format and may be up to 100MB.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A warning will display when an uploaded sequence listing does not conform to ST.24 or ST.25; if non-conforming, correct and reattach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multi-Doc PDF splitting and indexing
rubrics_metrics.description: PDF files that contain multiple documents must be separately indexed for proper identification in the USPTO Content Management System (CMS).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After uploading a multi-doc PDF click 'Split document', select a Document Description for each document, enter page ranges, add/remove document lines as needed, then select Done to keep indexing in the Image File Wrapper; Done must be selected to ensure indexing remains.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application Data Sheet (ADS) filing options
rubrics_metrics.description: There are three (3) ADS filing options: Web ADS, Upload ADS (PDF), and No ADS.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Web ADS provides required sections for completing the ADS; No ADS requires entry of data — title of invention, first named inventor, and correspondence address are required when No ADS selected. All ADS options provide a link to change ADS filing method.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required attachment for new applications
rubrics_metrics.description: At least one attachment other than the Patent Center generated fee sheet is required for New Applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure you attach substantive documents (e.g., specification) before submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Automatic document validation
rubrics_metrics.description: Documents are automatically validated when uploaded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Validation catches nonconforming file types, file size exceedances, sequence listing format issues, and missing document descriptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Validation error causes
rubrics_metrics.description: Documents cannot be validated when they do not comply with requirements such as incorrect file type, file size too large, sequence listing >100MB, or missing document description.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Errors include: uploaded document is not DOCX/PDF/TXT/PCT Zip; document file size exceeds 25MB; sequence listing in TXT exceeds 100MB; no document description selected. Use drop down list to select description and use type-ahead feature.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correcting document upload errors
rubrics_metrics.description: Correct document errors by removing the file, correcting the issue, and reattaching.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the three dot button to the right of the document to Remove; then reattach corrected file.

rubrics_metrics.name: Train stops navigation and autosave behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: The train stop feature at the top of the screen expands to show multiple components of the application process and can be used to move forward and backwards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use train stops to automatically save changes while moving through the filing; they save state and allow navigation between filing steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Saved Submissions retention and access
rubrics_metrics.description: Saved Submissions are retained and visible for the previous fourteen (14) calendar day period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users can continue with a saved submission by clicking the Patent Center ID; practitioners can filter by Created in/Created by; practitioner support users sort by Created by/Filed on Behalf of; all data sortable by headers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Workbench contents
rubrics_metrics.description: Patent Center Workbench provides access to Saved Submissions, Applications associated to the profile, and Correspondence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Workbench is visible to Registered Users; Guest Users see different account information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applications list filters and customization
rubrics_metrics.description: Users can filter Applications by Docket Number (Exact/Starts with/Contains), Status Category (All, New, Pending, Issued, Abandoned, Other), and Status Date (up to 365 days or Custom range).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Columns can be added/removed and sorted; download bibliographic data in XML by selecting checkboxes for applications or Select All.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correspondence filtering options
rubrics_metrics.description: Users may filter Correspondence by Correspondence method, Date type, and Image date with date ranges up to 90 days (or Custom range).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If filtering Regular correspondence only, filter by Image date; if e-Notifications only, filter by eNotification date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manage tools for Two-Step authenticated Registered Users
rubrics_metrics.description: Registered users with two-step authentication have Manage tools to handle Sponsorships, Customer Numbers, view saved/completed requests, and (coming soon) update application address.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Manage area columns sortable; provides administrative functions for profiles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sponsorships management rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Sponsors can see support staff sponsored by their profile, request history, pending requests, and sponsor additional users.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To add support staff enter USPTO.gov account email addresses separated by semicolon; sponsorships can be removed by selecting the 'x' next to the support user.

rubrics_metrics.name: Customer Number creation and editing
rubrics_metrics.description: Users can create a new customer number or select a customer number to update associated information; practitioners may import Address and/or Registered practitioners from an existing customer number associated to their profile.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practitioner registration numbers can be added by entering numbers in the provided box separated by spaces to add more than one; Independent Inventors may import an Address from another customer number associated to their profile.

rubrics_metrics.name: View saved and completed requests filters and actions
rubrics_metrics.description: Users can filter saved/completed requests by Type (All, New, Data change), Status (All, Failed, Submitted, Saved), and Date range up to 90 days (or Custom).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Columns sortable by header; saved requests can be deleted by selecting the 'x' next to the request information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allowed application and submission types
rubrics_metrics.description: Patent Center accepts new Design, International PCT Application (filing in US receiving office), Provisional, Utility, and U.S. National Stage under 35 USC 371, plus special initiatives and various existing submission types.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Special Patent Initiatives include Track One Prioritized Examination, Accelerated Examination – Utility, Accelerated Examination – Design. Existing submissions include Upload Documents/Pay Fees, Web 85b - Issue fee transmittal, eTerminal Disclaimer. Petitions and Post-grant requests (e.g., reissue, reexamination) are supported; see list for specific petition types.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow-on filing permission
rubrics_metrics.description: Only Registered Users may file documents in existing applications and patents (follow-on documents).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Registered Users must have the Confirmation Number and Application Number (tip: both required) to file follow-on submissions to ensure filing to the correct application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Important document upload behaviors and UI controls
rubrics_metrics.description: Users may upload via Drag and Drop or Select and Attach; for multi-section documents indicate description and pages; add more documents via Select file(s) and remove via three-dot menu.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enter document description when not detected; for multi-doc PDF after splitting, user can Download all documents or Preview them before continuing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multi-Doc splitting line limit
rubrics_metrics.description: Multi-Doc splitting is limited to 60 lines of document description (each line equals a document).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you add too many document lines, you can Remove a document line; ensure indexing remains by selecting Done after indexing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dynamic fee calculation inputs
rubrics_metrics.description: Fees are dynamically generated based on values entered: entity status (Regular, Small, or Micro), number of pages in the specification, total dependent claims, total independent claims, and whether multiple dependent claims are being filed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Micro entity applicants must provide certification (PTO/SB/15A and PTO/SB/15B); check boxes for other items such as petitions filed as part of the application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Option to skip fee payment at submission time
rubrics_metrics.description: Users may select 'Skip fees for now' or Continue without paying fees at submission time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selecting Skip fees may incur additional charges; warning provided that fees were not calculated and may be required on time to prevent delays and surcharges.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proceeding to fee calculation and payment and cancel warning
rubrics_metrics.description: Click 'Calculate fees' to select fees to pay; clicking 'Cancel submission' displays that all saved information will be lost and requires confirmation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If user selects Yes, cancel submission, they are directed to the login screen; ensure you choose 'No, continue submission' to avoid data loss.

rubrics_metrics.name: Confirm and Submit final checks
rubrics_metrics.description: Confirm and Submit provides the final opportunity to review/edit application data, edit fees, and remove or edit documents associated with the application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attempting to submit without calculating fees triggers a warning prompting fee calculation to avoid delays or surcharges.

rubrics_metrics.name: eFiler information population rule
rubrics_metrics.description: On the Submit screen, Guest Users must provide user information; for Registered Users this information is automatically retrieved from the profile.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure Guest Users complete required fields to successfully submit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission Receipt contents and actions
rubrics_metrics.description: Upon successful submission a Submission receipt is provided showing Application Number, Confirmation Number, Receipt Date, and bibliographic and other information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: User may print or save the receipt; the official filing receipt is mailed separately by the Office of Patent Application Processing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accepted payment methods for Registered Users
rubrics_metrics.description: Registered Users may pay fees to USPTO via USPTO Deposit Account, Credit Card, or Electronic Funds Transfer using Financial Manager.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Credit Card types accepted: VISA, MasterCard, American Express, Discover; after payment user is directed back to Patent Center.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accepted payment methods for Guest Users
rubrics_metrics.description: Guest Users may only pay by credit card.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guest Users must provide and confirm credit card and billing information; after successful payment they are returned to Patent Center.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment Receipt contents and options
rubrics_metrics.description: Payment Receipt displays the time (Eastern Time) and date the submission was received and bibliographic and payment information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Payment Receipt screen allows printing, saving, filing another patent application, or accessing Patent Center home page.

rubrics_metrics.name: File another submission tip
rubrics_metrics.description: Tip: Confirmation Number and Application Number are both required to file a follow-on submission to an existing application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep these identifiers handy to ensure documents are filed to the correct application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training mode for simulation
rubrics_metrics.description: Switch to training mode to access a simulation of filing and viewing an application; training mode displays a message 'You are currently working in training mode.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Quit Training Mode to leave the simulation and return to the Home page; training allows practice without submitting to USPTO.

rubrics_metrics.name: PDF compatibility advisory
rubrics_metrics.description: Although PDF is an open standard, not all PDF files are the same; users are urged to review information about compatible PDF files.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Quick Start Guide and other documentation for details on compatible PDFs to avoid validation/upload issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Warning about Customer Number omission
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide Customer Number: The submitted application will not be viewable under the Workbench section when a customer number associated with the profile is not used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Always provide a customer number associated with your profile to ensure the application appears in Workbench for retrieval and management.
